subject: Integrating Redwood SDK with LangChain tracing & prompt tooling — action items
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
To: Sophia Chen <sophia@langchain.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Integrating Redwood SDK with LangChain tracing & prompt tooling — action items

Hi Sophia —

Thanks again for the quick sync today. Short recap and proposed next steps for the integration between LangChain's SDK/tooling and Redwood's inference runtime:

1) Tracing header mapping: we propose exposing an opt-in Redwood trace header (X-Redwood-Trace) that the LangChain SDK can inject when a request is proxied to our hosted or dedicated endpoints. This will allow end-to-end trace correlation across prompts and tool calls.

2) Prompt tooling integration: LangChain's prompt templates can reference a new "redwood_batch_hint" metadata field to suggest batching/temperature presets to our optimizer. This is opt-in and purely advisory.

3) Quick-start lib: we'll provide a tiny wrapper (npm + PyPI) that demonstrates the header injection and how to attach the trace-id to LangChain chains/agents. Target: example in our repo + a short notebook.

4) Security & telemetry: LangChain asked about PII and token capture. We'll share a minimal schema that shows which fields are redwood-logged versus never-stored. (See attached: trace-schema-v1.json)

Attachments: redwood-langchain-integration-proposal.pdf, trace-schema-v1.json

Action items I propose:
- Sophia: confirm LangChain is okay with the X-Redwood-Trace header approach and advise on any naming constraints.
- Marissa / Karthik: scope an internal eng spike (2-3 days) to produce the wrapper libs and a canary demo.
- Sophia / Tom: provide a short acceptance checklist for the SDK (tracing, prompt-hint semantics, and telemetry opt-in).

Let's aim to have the first demo by next Thursday (2026-03-12). If that works I'll open HS-78921 and the PR in our repo.

Cheers,

Sergio Alvarez
Head of Partnerships — Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0193

From: Sophia Chen <sophia@langchain.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Hart <tom.hart@consultfy.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 06 Mar 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Integrating Redwood SDK with LangChain tracing & prompt tooling — action items

Hi Sergio —

Appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers inline: 

- X-Redwood-Trace header: fine with us, though LangChain prefers vendor-neutral naming where possible. Can we support an alias (X-Trace-Provider: redwood) or make it configurable so existing customers don't need to change their chains?

- Prompt hint: thumbs up on an advisory field. We'll call it `redwood.batch_hint` in the metadata to avoid collisions.

- Wrapper libs: great. We'll want both the Node and Python clients. If you can provide an example agent that preserves trace-context across tool calls, that will speed adoption.

- Telemetry: please share the minimal schema (we saw trace-schema-v1.json) and also a short legal-friendly blurb we can share with enterprise customers who ask about data residency.

Tom from ConsultFy (cc) will help us evaluate some professional services for the glue work (if needed).

I'll follow up with a short acceptance checklist by Monday (Mar 9) and we'll try to scope the first demo for Mar 12.

Thanks —

Sophia Chen
Developer Relations — LangChain
@sophia-lc

Thanks all — quick engineering note and plan: 

1) Spike scope (2 business days):
- Gateway change to accept configurable trace header name and alias mapping (config at tenant-level for Dedicated; global toggle for Hosted).
- A tiny middleware in our Node/Python SDKs that reads trace context from LangChain request context and injects header.
- Unit/integration test that exercises trace propagation across chain -> tool -> model request.

2) Canary/demo plan:
- Create a small sample app (langchain-agent-redwood) that runs a chain with one tool (Wikipedia lookup) and demonstrates trace correlation in Redwood Console traces.
- Demo script + short Loom (3-4 min) that shows: make request from LangChain agent, show trace id in console, show trace linked to tokens and cost breakdown.

3) Security: we'll follow the schema in trace-schema-v1.json and redact any prompt fields flagged as PII. We'll produce the legal-friendly blurb for Sophia.

I'll open PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/langchain-integration/pull/42 with the spike branch and ping when ready. If LangChain wants us to use a vendor-neutral alias, we'll accept both (X-Redwood-Trace + X-Trace-Provider or configurable).

Action owner assignments:
- Karthik: spike + PR + demo artifacts (ETA 2 business days, branch/PR).
- Marissa: coordinate demo invite + partner comms.
- Sergio: finalize HS record and commercial note (if ConsultFy will be engaged for paid gluing work).

I'll update HS-78921 with progress.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Integrations — Redwood Inference
